projects.description: Highlights: Rework Reduction at Extruder through Machine Learning (ML) Overview: Developed a machine learning-based solution to minimize rework by  optimizing  the extrusion recipe  values. Tech Stack: Python, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy,RandomForest,XGBoost Description: Collected and analyzed data (temperature, pressure, current, etc.) from the Azure Databricks.                                                        Applied regression models to predict and get optimum values for critical parameters to prevent material defects and inconsistencies that lead to rework.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               Built a predictive model get optimum values which improving the overall quality and yield of extruded products.                                      Reduced rework no.s from 7no.s tread scrap to 4 no.s ,( 42% rework reduction )leading to cost savings. Result: Reduced rework no.s from 7no.s tread scrap to 4 no.s ,( 42% rework reduction )leading to cost savings. Defect Classification System using Company Dataset Overview: Built a machine learning classification system to predict whether an extruded tread component will pass or fail. Tech Stack: Python, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy,RandomForest,XGBoost Description: Collected and analyzed SCADA data (temperature, pressure, current, etc.) from the extruder machines.                                        Applied classification models to classify the tread will be a Ok tread or Not ok tread. Result: Achieved 93% accuracy in defect classification. Scrap Detection by using YOLO-Based Computer Vision System Overview: Designed and deployed a real-time scrap detection system using the YOLO (You Only Look Once) object detection algorithm to identify defective materials of  single belt   in Tyre building  manufacturing process. Tech Stack: Python,YOLOv8, TensorFlow, CCTV Cameras Description: Collected video footage from belt conveyors to build a labeled dataset of scrap and non-scrap materials.                                 Trained a YOLOv8 model to detect scrap items with high accuracy under movement conditions.                                                                                   Integrated the model with a live video stream and a real-time  system that stop the machine in case of single belt scenario. Result: Achieved over 97% accuracy in real-time scrap detection. Agentic AI projects: . Financial Agents with CrewAI framework PDF assistant  with PHIDATA framework Multiagent_system_with autogen framework
